doc.tool: Current state with the front (third-person) and wrist images.

doc.code:
Hand pose, gripper width and command, success and step count.

Example:
    st = state()
    print(st["eef_pos"], st["gripper_width"], st["yaw_deg"], st["success"])

gripper.description: Open or close the gripper first (default: keep)

return_frames.description: Also return the front frame after every decision

doc.tool: Translate the gripper by a base-frame [dx, dy, dz] in metres (+x away from the base, +y toward the robot's left, +z up; at most {{max_move}} m per call), optionally opening or closing the gripper first. The orientation is held. Returns the new state and images.
doc.code:
Translate the hand by a base-frame delta (m, at most 0.3 per call), optionally after a gripper command; the orientation is held.

Example:
    move_delta([0, 0, 0.1], gripper="open")  # open, then lift 10 cm
    r = move_delta([0.05, 0, -0.1])
    print(r["moved_m"], r["eef_pos"])

yaw.description: rad about the base vertical (+ = counter-clockwise seen from above)

return_frames.description: Also return every decision's front frame

doc.tool: Turn the gripper by `yaw` radians about the vertical axis through it (+ = counter-clockwise seen from above, - = clockwise; at most {{max_rotate}} rad per call), holding its position and downward tilt. The wrist view turns with it. Returns the new state and images.
doc.code:
Turn the hand by a yaw (rad) about the base vertical axis through it (+ = counter-clockwise seen from above; clipped to 0.3 per call), holding its position and tilt.

Example:
    r = rotate_delta(0.3)  # counter-clockwise seen from above
    print(r["yaw"], r["yaw_deg"])

depth.description: Also return the depth map, [rgb, depth_m]

doc.code:
The latest frame of a camera.

Example:
    rgb = render_camera("agentview")  # uint8 [H, W, 3]
    wrist = render_camera("wrist")      # fingertips at the top

camera_name.description: Only the front camera has a fixed calibration

doc.code:
The front camera's intrinsics and camera-to-base extrinsic.

Example:
    meta = get_camera_meta("agentview")
    K, T = meta["intrinsic_K"], meta["extrinsic_cam2world"]

One raw relative-IK control step [dx, dy, dz, drx, dry, drz, gripper] (no orientation hold).

Example:
    r = step([0, 0, 0.02, 0, 0, 0, 0])  # up, gripper open (> 0.5 closes)
    print(r["state"]["eef_pos"], r["terminated"])

Raw control steps [N, 7] in one call.

Example:
    r = chunk_step([[0, 0, -0.02, 0, 0, 0, 0]] * 8)  # 8 steps down
    print(r["obs"]["eef_pos"], r["terminated"])
